name: Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor
author: Wow Elements

sections.description:
Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor is a feature-rich plugin crafted to supercharge the Elementor page builder with advanced slider widgets that are powerful, flexible, and easy to use.

Perfect for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users, Wow Sliders lets you create visually stunning, fully responsive sliders that increase engagement and elevate your website’s design.

Key Features

Image Carousel – A modern Swiper effect that makes your slides come alive.

Wow Sliders extends Elementor with lightweight, performance-focused widgets that enhance creativity and usability — without slowing down your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wow-sliders-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor and start using the new slider widgets.
sections.faq:
What do I need to use this plugin?

Just install Wow Sliders along with Elementor. Once activated, the plugin provides all essential slider widgets directly in the Elementor editor.

How to Use Widgets

To use an Elementor widget, first go to the plugin settings in your WordPress admin dashboard and open the Widgets menu.
Enable the widget you want to use, then click Save Changes.

Next, open any page with the Elementor editor.
You will find a new widget category called “Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor.”
All available widgets, including the Image Carousel, will appear under this category and are ready to use.

How do I get support if I face an issue?

Open a support thread on the plugin’s WordPress.org support forum. Our team will follow up as soon as possible.

How do I receive updates?

When a new version is released, WordPress will notify you on the Plugins page. You can update directly from there like any other plugin.
